SAP Basis & Cloud Administrator | SAP BTP, RISE Migration, Cloud ALM, HANA | Remote from Romania 
 At CrewHarbor, we connect German companies with experienced SAP and IT professionals from Romania.
 For one of our partners, we are looking for an experienced SAP Basis & Cloud Administrator who combines strong expertise in traditional SAP system administration with hands-on knowledge of modern SAP cloud technologies and RISE with SAP migrations.
 ⚙️ What you’ll work on 
 • Administer, monitor, and maintain SAP system landscapes
 • Perform SAP installations, system copies, upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities
 • Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize system performance and availability
 • Support SAP HANA environments, migrations, and related system adjustments
 • Participate in RISE with SAP migration projects , including system preparation, technical migration activities, and post-migration support
 • Integrate SAP BTP solutions and cloud services into existing SAP environments
 • Support the implementation and administration of SAP Cloud ALM
 • Contribute to SAP cloud transformation initiatives and the integration of SAP Joule and other modern SAP services
 • Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders and document technical changes and processes
 🔎 What we’re looking for 
 • Several years of experience in SAP Basis administration or a similar technical SAP role
 • Strong hands-on experience with SAP installations, system copies, upgrades, maintenance, and troubleshooting
 • Practical experience with SAP BTP services and their integration into existing SAP landscapes
 • Experience with SAP Cloud ALM and modern SAP cloud or hybrid environments
 • Experience with RISE with SAP migrations or SAP S/4HANA cloud migration projects
 • Knowledge of SAP HANA environments and migrations
 • Good understanding of operating systems, databases, interfaces, and SAP technical architecture
 • Exposure to SAP Joule or other SAP AI and automation technologies is an advantage
 • Good English communication skills; German is a plus
 What we offer 
 • Fully remote setup from Romania, with no overtime culture
 • The opportunity to contribute to an SAP cloud transformation and RISE migration projects
 • A role combining SAP Basis expertise with BTP, RISE with SAP, Cloud ALM, HANA, and modern SAP technologies
 • An international project environment with strong professional exchange
 • Stable, long-term collaboration
 • Market-leading compensation based on experience
 📩 Application
 Please send your CV in English to career@crewharbor.de or apply directly through LinkedIn.
